title: Who we are
metaDescription: Meet St John's Park, learn what we believe, and get to know the leadership and church family serving Park, Sheffield.

sections.title: Who We Are
sections.body: St John's Park is part of the Church of England in the Diocese of Sheffield. We want to be a church that worships Jesus deeply, serves our neighbours faithfully, and makes room for people of every age and background to belong.

image.alt: Church family worshipping together at St John's Park

sections.title: Our Story
sections.body: Our life together is shaped by belonging to God's family, learning from his Word, supporting each other well, and loving our local community with practical care and open-handed welcome.
points: We are part of the Church of England in the Diocese of Sheffield.
We want the church to be spiritually grounded and genuinely local.
We care about worship, discipleship, generosity, and long-term presence in Park.

image.alt: A stained glass cross inside the church building

sections.title: What We Believe
sections.contentHtml:
St John's is part of the Church of England in the Diocese of Sheffield. We are committed to being followers of Jesus who love and learn from God, support each other, and serve our community and beyond.

Our faith is well summarised in the Apostles' Creed and the historic Christian conviction that God is Father, Son, and Holy Spirit; that Jesus died and rose again; and that forgiveness, resurrection, and new life are found in him.

We want our belief to become visible in everyday life: worship that is sincere, friendship that is generous, service that is practical, and mission that stays rooted in hope.

sections.title: Safeguarding
sections.body: We are committed to high standards in the safeguarding and care of children and vulnerable adults across all areas of church life.
